method: Read the remaining 12 phrase source contexts and the 20 flagged paragraphs against the existing recovered index. New phrase entries address concrete gaps; uncertain quotation boundaries remain pending. Codex editorial judgment is separate from automated source checks and independent human review.
phrases: a handful of
a small number of people or things
少数；几个
Only a handful of people joined the meeting.
只有几个人参加了会议。
Figurative small quantity with a plural count noun, not literally a hand full of students; useful for attendees, customers and examples.
end up following
eventually follow someone, as the result of earlier events
最后跟着……走；结果一路跟随
We missed the signs and ended up following another group.
我们没看到路标，最后跟着另一组人走了。
End up takes an -ing form. Source describes an eventual action without proving it was planned; also useful for ending up following a colleague's advice.
it doesn't look like
the available appearance or evidence suggests something is not so
看起来不像；看来并没有
It doesn't look like the changes were saved.
看起来修改没有保存。
Use a full clause after like here. The source limits the observation to released footage; a visual impression is not conclusive proof.
right before
immediately before something happens
就在……之前
The client called right before the meeting.
客户就在开会前打来了电话。
Right intensifies closeness in time, not correctness or direction. Learn right before leaving and right before the deadline.
to give some context
to provide background that helps explain something
补充一点背景
To give some context, this team was formed only last month.
补充一点背景，这个团队上个月才成立。
A discourse introduction, followed by relevant background. The quoted sentence runs into segment 57; do not use its false start as a grammar model.
all things considered
after weighing the relevant good and bad aspects
综合考虑；总的来说
All things considered, the trip went well.
总的来说，这趟旅行还算顺利。
Can precede or follow an overall judgment. Source is the narrator's assessment of intensity, not confirmation that every fact was verified.
blocked the car
prevented a car from moving or passing
挡住了车；阻止车辆通行
A fallen branch blocked the car's path.
一根掉落的树枝挡住了车的去路。
Blocked refers to physical movement, not blocking a user online. Source is part of the president's reported account and must remain attributed.
release a public statement
make an official message available to the public
发布公开声明
The company plans to release a public statement tomorrow.
公司计划明天发布公开声明。
Release means publish here. Distinguish an institutional statement from the narrator's response to it; useful for organizations, not casual personal chat.
caught up in
involved in a difficult or unwanted situation
卷入；陷入
We got caught up in a long argument about the schedule.
我们陷入了一场关于日程的长时间争论。
Be/get caught up in + situation. In the source, involvement in a scandal does not itself establish wrongdoing; distinct from catch up with someone.
get a fair shake
receive fair treatment or a fair opportunity
得到公平对待或公平的机会
Everyone deserves to get a fair shake in the interview.
每个人都应该在面试中得到公平对待。
Informal American idiom: shake is not physical shaking. Source attributes the prediction of unfair treatment to someone else; it is not endorsed.
not the other way around
not with the roles, order or relationship reversed
而不是反过来
The tool should support the team, not the other way around.
工具应该服务于团队，而不是反过来。
Reusable reversal contrast. The source's separate word essayed is unresolved; reviewing this phrase does not approve that word or validate the allegation.
at least
not less than a stated minimum
至少
At least three people need access to the folder.
至少有三个人需要访问这个文件夹。
Minimum-quantity sense before one accused; not the consolation sense in at least nobody was hurt. The source sentence continues in 108.
makes the news
becomes a subject of news reporting
成为新闻；登上新闻报道
A small community project rarely makes the news.
一个小型社区项目很少登上新闻。
Make the news is not manufacture news. Here it introduces why the incident attracted attention, not a claim about the accuracy of coverage.
strange conclusion
an unusual or puzzling outcome or judgment
奇怪的结局或结论
The report reaches a strange conclusion from very little evidence.
报告仅凭很少的证据就得出了一个奇怪的结论。
Ordinary adjective–noun combination; conclusion can mean outcome or judgment. The preceding account makes the narrator's puzzlement about responsibility salient.
nevertheless
despite what has just been said
尽管如此；然而
The route was longer; nevertheless, we arrived on time.
路线更长了，尽管如此，我们还是按时到达。
Contrastive discourse adverb often used in formal speech and writing. In this transition it does not supply missing evidence about the event.
footage
recorded moving images of an event
视频画面；影像资料
We reviewed the security footage after the alarm.
警报响起后，我们查看了监控录像。
Uncountable in this sense: some footage or a piece of footage, not a footage. The narrator has seen released material, not necessarily all recordings.
been released
been made available for people to see or use
已被公布；已被发布
The updated instructions have been released.
更新后的说明已经发布了。
Been released forms a perfect passive after has/have. In that's been released, that's means that has, and that refers to the footage.
back out of
move backward out of a space, especially in a vehicle
倒着驶出；倒退出
She carefully backed out of the garage.
她小心地把车倒出了车库。
Physical movement in back out of the parking spot; distinguish the figurative back out of a deal, meaning withdraw from an agreement.
so that
with the result or purpose that something happens
以便；使得
I moved the lamp so that I could read more easily.
我挪了挪灯，以便看书更方便。
Links the person's position to the car's inability to back out. The connector can express purpose or result; source phrasing alone cannot prove intention.
automatic braking system
a vehicle system designed to apply the brakes automatically under specified conditions
自动制动系统
The manual explains the automatic braking system's limitations.
手册说明了自动制动系统的局限。
Technical noun phrase, not a synonym for self-driving. The quoted claim about maneuvering remains the speaker's account and is not verified as a vehicle capability.
silencing speech
preventing someone from expressing views
压制言论；阻止他人发声
They argued that the rule risked silencing speech.
他们认为，这条规定可能会压制言论。
Silence is a verb meaning suppress expression, not merely reduce volume. Motive is alleged by the quoted speaker, not established by this vocabulary entry.
by default
as an assumed consequence when no separate choice or distinction is made
默认地；顺带也就……
By default, new files are saved in this folder.
默认情况下，新文件保存在这个文件夹里。
Default is literal system behavior in the teaching example; source uses it loosely to extend responsibility from the university to its president. That is the narrator's inference, not a legal rule.
going against
opposing someone or taking a contrary position
反对；站到……的对立面
Several team members were going against the proposal.
几位团队成员反对这个提案。
Opposition sense, not physical travel against a direction. The source does not establish whether criticism is justified.
seemingly
apparently, though not known for certain
似乎；表面上看来
A seemingly simple task took the whole afternoon.
一项看似简单的任务花了整个下午。
Signals appearance rather than certainty. Source's seemingly released describes the narrator's impression of the stream of messages.
being analyzed
undergoing careful examination
正在被分析或仔细研究
The survey responses are being analyzed.
调查回复正在被分析。
Present-progressive passive: are being + past participle. It describes an ongoing process without naming the analysts or proving the conclusions.
segments: News attention and the puzzling outcome/judgment are now taught alongside incident and bizarre; reason is because is conversational redundancy, not a second cause.
The contrast transition, university leadership role and building location are all explained; as introduces simultaneous events.
The recording noun and perfect passive now complement the cautious visual impression. That's means that has, and the statement is restricted to what the narrator saw.
Reverse movement and the purpose/result connector are explicitly explained; the speaker's confidence does not independently prove the student's intent.
Both the braking-system phrase and controlled movement are taught. This covers understanding the reported claim, not technical validation that braking alone could steer the car.
Harassment and intimidation are linked with suppressing expression; with the direct motive of attributes an alleged purpose to the quoted speaker, not a proven motive.
By default is explicitly noted as a loose inference about institutional responsibility; deemed means judged, and can't come back describes the narrated exclusion.
Consulted the existing prosecutor card as well as the two idioms: commenting, fair treatment and the legal role now explain the conditional reported opinion without endorsing it.
Ongoing passive analysis, apparent publication and the informal frequency estimate are distinguished; the trailing comma is preserved and no analyzer or release date is invented.
